summary: Narrow lane beside the rail line with apartments a few metres off the kerb.
reasons: No Stopping signs along the stretch

best_section.where: Railway Avenue, midway down opposite the rail trees

drivers.seclusion: Mapped apartments 3 m and 6 m from the kerb at 46 m and 120 m, and a house 1 m at 13 m; buildings line the east side throughout.
drivers.access_and_room: Public lane, but a few cars squeeze along the kerb and the west side is rail corridor; little room to pull clear.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end-style lane beside a four-track rail corridor; train noise.
drivers.convention: A few cars park at the kerb, but No Stopping 7-9am Mon-Fri signs run along it.

flags: Steep: about 4.6% over best section, 5.7% mean, 14% max
No Stopping Specified Times Mon-Fri 7-9am and No Stopping Any Time signs
sun_shade: Rail-side trees shade the west edge in the afternoon; open to the sky otherwise.
cannot_judge: Exact usable room beside the lane
